note: Fixed prices, agreed in writing before I start. No hourly surprises and no hidden fees. Prices are shown in USD and adjust to your region.

faq.q: How do I know which plan I need?
faq.a: Tell me what you're building and I'll point you to the right one — usually on a single short call. You don't have to pick from this page alone.

faq.q: Why do some prices say "starting at"?
faq.a: The build price is fixed, but the final number moves with scope — page count, product count or how many screens you need. You get the exact figure in a written proposal before any work begins.
Half up front to book your slot, half on launch. Monthly plans are billed at the start of each month and you can cancel any time.
Third-party costs — domains, hosting fees, paid Shopify apps, stock images and premium fonts — are billed at cost. I'll list any of these in the proposal so there are no surprises.

faq.q: Can you take over a site someone else built?
faq.a: Yes. I'll audit what's there first and tell you honestly whether it's better to fix it or rebuild it. The audit fee comes off the project if you go ahead.
